ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low. The visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, with high-intensity (white/tan) pixels occupying less than 2% of the total surface area, primarily at the left distal tip.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region covering >98% of the visible fluke; localized high-contrast cluster of tan and white pixels situated on the superior distal margin of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 40-45 degrees and a vertical depth estimated at 12-15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, low-amplitude serrations present along the trailing margins of both lobes; the right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of small pixel-amplitude variations (nicks) compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer lateral margins of both lobes, tapering smoothly from the peduncle toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups located on the superior edge of the left fluke tip, appearing as a dense, textured colony.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized encrustation/physical accumulation on the distal tip of the left lobe, creating a jagged profile relative to the right tip.
